resources.string: Open 1337 Player to resume the saved queue.

1337 Player is based on Myspoti (kota-zo/myspoti) and distributed under GPL-3.0. Original copyright notices are preserved. Source and releases: https://github.com/everth1337/1337-player. Complete corresponding source for each release is provided alongside the APK in 1337-Player-source.zip. Bundled extensions retain their authorship and licenses.
Two selected extensions · no separate account
Looks for matching songs on YouTube Music and saves AAC/M4A. Some tracks may be unavailable.
Adds Latin readings under Japanese and Korean lyrics, offline. Readings can be imperfect; this is not a translation.
For AAC downloads, choose the small file size in download quality. Wait for the download to finish before going offline. Music comes from the selected source, not Spotify.
